name: Kallai
title: Priestly Head in Nehemiah's Time
summary: Kallai was a priestly head from the family of Sallus in Jerusalem after the return from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in Nehemiah 12 as one of the leading priests under the high priest Joiakim, son of Jeshua. His role was to serve in the temple and lead the priestly family he belonged to.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among Priestly Heads
keyEvents.description: Kallai is mentioned as head of the Sallai family in the list of priestly leaders during the time of high priest Joiakim.

keyEvents.title: Service Under Joiakim
keyEvents.description: Kallai served as a priestly leader during the period when Joiakim, son of Jeshua, was high priest in the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Priestly Leadership After the Exile
keyEvents.description: Kallai was part of the organized priesthood that was restored after the return from Babylon, which was crucial for the religious rebuilding of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Registration of the Priests
keyEvents.description: The name of Callai was recorded in the official chronicles of priestly family heads, testifying to the accurate keeping of genealogical records in the post-exilic period.
